== Service claim needs a source ==
The article calls this person a Decipherian (a Decipher staff member) based on the fan anagram list, but the page has no inline citation, and no source found so far gives a Decipher role or dates. Under the Service-table rule (Bill, 2026-10-14), service mentioned on a person page must be a cited row in its == Service == table. The article was left unchanged; please add a source (and then a Service row), or remove the claim. == Two Madisons in the Two-Player Game credits (27 October 2026) ==

=== Possibly faulty data ===
* The [[Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game]] rules booklet lists "Bob Madison, Will Madison" as two separate playtesters ([https://www.hasbro.com/common/instruct/Star_Wars_Customizable_Card_Game.PDF Introductory Two-Player Game Rules Booklet] (1995), credits page ([https://web.archive.org/web/20261015192404/https://www.hasbro.com/common/instruct/Star_Wars_Customizable_Card_Game.PDF Preserved copy])). The fan anagram list gives "[Bob/Will] Madison" for [[Imperial Trooper Guard Dainsom]] and does not say which of them is meant. The article now treats Bob and [[Will Madison]] as two people and leaves the anagram unassigned.
=== Marginal cuts ===
* The lead no longer says "Bob Madison or Will Madison was a Decipherian", and the undated "Decipherian" Service row was replaced by the cited 1995 playtester row: the fan list's "Decipherian" applies to one Madison, and the sources do not say which.
* Removed the Sources list (prose page); the anagram list and Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2 are refs in the lead with checked Preserved copies.
